content_sections.heading: About MANIT Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: This Junior Research Fellow position is created under the funded research project titled "A Synergistic Deep Learning Approach for Accurate Scour Prediction Around Bridge Piers" (File No. A/RD/RP-2/450). The project is funded by the Madhya Pradesh Council of Science and Technology (MPCST), Bhopal, and involves Principal Investigator Dr. Rutuja M. Chavan, Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, MANIT Bhopal, and Co-Principal Investigator Dr. Vaibhav Soni, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, MANIT Bhopal.
